title: fix(schema-catalog): author the five stacked-label flex roots as direction "col"
body:
Fixes #8761
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

Five schema-catalog entries author a label stacked above its control as a `flex` root with `"direction": "column"`, the CSS spelling. `FlexSchema.direction` declares `row | col | row-reverse | col-reverse`, and the `flex` renderer maps only `col` / `col-reverse` to a column class. So:

- `safeValidateSchema` (and `objectui validate`) refused each document: `invalid_value` at `direction`, the ONLY issue on each one;
- the renderer emitted no direction class, so each root kept the flexbox default and drew the label BESIDE its control.

The card named two (`components-form-label/*`). A tree-wide grep finds exactly five, all `flex` roots, all under `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/`; the claim put the other three in scope.

## The fix

`"column"` to `"col"` in the five fixtures. Per the triage ruling, `FlexSchema.direction` is ⛔ not widened and `packages/types` is untouched.

## Premises, measured on the branch point `961ceaa32`

| # | premise | reading |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `FlexSchema.direction` is `z.enum(['row', 'col', 'row-reverse', 'col-reverse'])` | Holds (printed from `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`). Through the built `@object-ui/types/zod`: before, all five REFUSE with `{"code":"invalid_value","path":["direction"]}` and nothing else; after, all five ACCEPT and `AnyComponentSchema.safeParse` is `true`. Controls in the same runs: `components-form-select/basic-select` ACCEPT; a synthetic flex with `col` ACCEPT, with `column` REFUSE. |
| 2 | five `"direction": "column"` sites | Holds, and every node is `type: "flex"` (printed per file). A regex over every quoting and spacing of a `direction` key with the value `column`, whole tree: the same five and nothing else (nothing in `content/docs`, `packages`, `apps`). Control: the same regex with `col` returns 12 hits. |
| 3 | the renderer draws a row for `column`, a column for `col` | Holds. The `flex` renderer's class map has a `direction === 'col'` arm (`flex-col`) and no `column` arm. Render reading, real `SchemaRenderer` plus the real registry: with `column` the root's classes are `flex justify-start items-start` plus the gap ladder, no direction token (the CSS default, a row); with `col` they include `flex-col`. |
| 4 | docs reachability | See the next section. |

### ⚠️ One claim on the card is wrong: `objectui check` does NOT refuse these files

The card and the triage grading say `objectui check` refuses the key. Measured before the fix, `objectui check` run inside each of the four category directories prints `All checks passed`, exit 0. The cause is the recogniser's design: a root that carries a structural key (`children`, here) is admitted as an ObjectUI file and judged on its `type` only; the full parse runs only for files the structural arm does not admit. The command that refuses them is `objectui validate FILE`: before, exit 1 on each of the five (`Invalid option: expected one of "row"|"col"|"row-reverse"|"col-reverse"`, `Path: direction`); after, exit 0, `Schema is valid!`. Control: `components-form-select/basic-select.json`, exit 0 both times. The docs that set up that belief are reported below as a finding, not changed here.

## Docs reachability (triage asked; objectui#8623 is the throw class)

All five are embedded in published docs pages:

| entry | page |
|---|---|
| `components-form-label/form-label`, `components-form-label/required-label` | `content/docs/components/form/label.mdx` |
| `components-form-date-picker/form-field` | `content/docs/components/form/date-picker.mdx` |
| `components-form-input-otp/verification-form` | `content/docs/components/form/input-otp.mdx` |
| `components-form-radio-group/form-field` | `content/docs/components/form/radio-group.mdx` |

⛔ None of them THROWS. The objectui#8623 throw is `getExample` on an unknown id, and these ids exist (`pnpm check:doc-example-ids`: every real reference is in the registry). The render path (`SchemaExample`, then `InteractiveDemo`, then `SchemaRenderer`) does not validate in production; the dev-mode check is a `console.warn` plus a `data-obj-schema-invalid` attribute, never a throw. ⇒ What readers of those four pages got: the preview drew the label beside its control, and the Code tab (`JSON.stringify` of the schema) taught `"direction": "column"`, which `objectui validate` refuses. The reach is wider than the card's two fixtures on one page, but it is not the throw class. Re-pricing is the seat's call.

## Pin

No existing test walks the catalog through `safeValidateSchema`: `safe-validate-corpus-6318` and `text-variant-corpus-6942` pin named entries and one category, and `catalog-gallery-render` fails only on an unregistered type (`flex` is registered, which is how this survived). So, per the order, a small pin for these five only (⛔ no catalog-wide walker), `examples/schema-catalog/test/flex-direction-col-8761.test.tsx`:

- each validates under `safeValidateSchema` (a full parse, because this is a value rule);
- each is a `flex` root authoring `direction: "col"` (names the key, so deleting `direction`, which parses and draws a row, cannot pass);
- each renders its `flex` root with `flex-col` and without `flex-row`;
- counter-probe: a flex with `column` is refused with exactly `invalid_value` at `direction`, and `col` passes.

It deliberately pins nothing about how the renderer treats an undeclared `direction` value.

### Ablation (one-time, not kept)

Fix committed first (`03742347a`). Then all five fixtures were put back to `"column"` through nested `ablation-replace` WRAP legs (per file: anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob changed) and the pin was re-run:

```
Test Files  1 failed (1)
     Tests  15 failed | 1 passed (16)
```

All 15 fixture rows went red (5 parse, 5 key, 5 render, the render ones reading `expected [ 'flex', 'justify-start', …(3) ] to include 'flex-col'`); the counter-probe stayed green, as it should. Restore proven per file by the tool (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty) and re-checked afterwards by hash for all five.

## Verification, at `03742347a`

| command | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 examples/schema-catalog/` (repo root) | 34 files, 2198 tests passed |
| the 56 test files outside the package that read the catalog (`git grep -l schema-catalog` over test files, plus `scripts/__tests__/extract-mdx-demos.test.ts`) | 56 files, 1486 tests passed |
| the new pin alone | 16 passed |
| `objectui validate` on the five fixtures | before exit 1 each; after exit 0 each |
| `objectui check` in the four category directories | exit 0 before and after (see above) |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | OK |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 new citations |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | no changeset owed (the package is `private`) |
| `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` | links valid |
| `pnpm check:doc-example-ids` | every real reference resolves |
| `python3 scripts/regenerate-catalog-index.py --check` | index up to date |
| `pnpm check:doc-types`, `node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:entry-guard` | all green |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the six paths | NOT GOVERNED |

Declared narrowings:

- **Type-check**: `tsc -p` a temporary config that extends `examples/schema-catalog/tsconfig.test.json` with only the new test file, against freshly built `types` / `core` / `react` / `components` (and their closure): 0 errors; `--listFiles` shows the test file and the built `packages/types`, `packages/react` and `packages/components` declaration entry points in the program. The package-wide `type-check` needs every plugin built and is left to CI's `Type Check`.
- **Lint**: `eslint --format json` on the new test file: 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The JSON fixtures are outside eslint's config (it answers "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied"). Type-aware linting is not enabled (`eslint.config.js` has no `parserOptions` / `projectService`; control: 13 `rules` hits in the same file), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.

Text-pin sweep: `git grep` for the five ids and file names outside the generated index and `content/docs` finds one hit, a comment in `packages/types/src/__tests__/text-value-retired-6951.test.ts` listing entries another card rewrote; that file ran in the 56-file set, green. The generated index imports the JSON by path and carries no schema content.

## Acceptance notes

- **Found, reported to the seat, not changed here**: `objectui check` never parses a file that its structural arm admits, so it does not list those files when they fail validation. Two docs pages describe it as if it did. `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` (the authoring-time door) says it lists the files that carry a registered component type but did not validate. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` says the retired `body` refusal is delivered by `objectui validate` / `objectui check`. Measured with a throwaway `{ "type": "chatbot", "messages": [], "body": {…} }`: `validate` refuses at `body` (exit 1), and `check` does not list the file, because `body` is itself a structural marker. Control in the same `check` run: a chatbot with no structural key and a bad `messages` IS listed.
- **Observation, no card**: the `flex` renderer turns any undeclared `direction` into no class, which gives a row. The card asked whether it should refuse instead. The triage ruled on the fixtures only, and after this PR no fixture or docs page in the tree authors an undeclared value (measured above). Carrier: none.
